끓이다.n: a person boils a liquid or soup; takes an object
cf: liquid itself boils or bubbles with heat; no object taken
cook food like noodles or eggs in boiling water

첫.n: Modifier that must precede a noun, as in first time; cannot stand alone
cf: Adverb meaning before others or ahead, as in going first
Ordinal noun for firstly when listing points, or the eldest child

벗기다.e: to undress; to take off; to peel
벗기다.n: take clothes off another person, or peel skin and shells
cf: neutral, take off your own clothes, shoes, hat or glasses

높임법.n: the grammar system of honorifics; subject, listener, object

바닷바람.n: everyday spoken word for wind blowing from the sea
cf: any soft light wind, literary, not tied to the sea

잠버릇.n: things one does in sleep, like tossing or snoring
cf: habit of speech; way of speaking
word or manner of speaking repeated unconsciously
what hands tend to do, often bad, like touching or stealing
Means ordinary and frequently seen, not rare.
